# Send your first event

Every request needs an API key. Create one under **Settings → API keys**; keys starting with `test_` never touch live data.

1. Install the SDK.
2. Set `NORTHWIND_KEY` in your environment.
3. Send the event below.

> Keys are shown once. Store yours in a secret manager, never in source control.

See the [authentication guide](/docs/auth) for scopes and rotation.
Copied. Paste it into your environment, not your code.
